review_request: Parent-delivered mandatory C03 J2 findings F1 and F2. Original author correction only; no acceptance review and no private evaluation material accessed.

changes.finding: C03 F1: total Spawn operations versus concurrent blocking callers
changes.before: Floods 20 trees with 1000 Lists plus 100 concurrent spawns, reverses List replies, and asserts correct per-caller identity.
changes.after: Floods 20 trees with 1000 Lists while four concurrent threads each make 25 sequential blocking spawn_on calls (100 Spawn operations total during the flood); reverses List replies and asserts correct per-caller identity.
changes.reason: The flood configures four threads and 25 calls per thread. Each thread sequentially collects synchronous spawn_on results; spawn_on invokes Gen::call, which waits with recv_timeout. The total is 100 additional Spawn operations during the flood, not an assertion of 100 simultaneously pending Spawn requests.

changes.finding: C03 F2: group/other write access versus owner write permission
changes.before: Unix candidate tests reject writable binary/directory modes and missing directories.
changes.after: Unix candidate tests accept an owned directory and binary at 0755 (owner write allowed), reject modes granting group or other write access (binary 0777; directories 0777, 0775 and 01777), and reject missing directories.
changes.reason: The test accepts an owned directory and binary at 0755, rejects a 0777 binary and directory modes 0777/0775/01777, and still rejects a missing directory. trusted checks permission mask 0o022, which targets group and other write bits, not owner write.

additional_inputs.used_for: spawn_on lines 142–152 calls Gen::call and consumes the reply before returning; supports the blocking sequential call characterization.
Gen::call lines 233–247 is a blocking round trip and waits through recv_timeout; supports the blocking characterization of each per-thread spawn_on call.
trusted lines 264–277 checks mode mask 0o022 and treats a missing directory differently from an absent candidate binary; supports group/other write scope and missing-directory rejection.
